qualification: local A05.3 rejected mixed-compiler chaining experiment; not A05.3 closure, cross-host, G1-G5, or release qualification

candidate.boundary: Legacy baseline and optimizing sources could link into tier-one targets because the legacy state model leaves materialized RFLAGS. Tier-one-to-legacy transitions remained dispatcher-separated.
candidate.regressionCoverage: A legacy-only memory bit-test and conditional branch linked into tier-one ADC, preserving carry and complete architectural state while removing one warm dispatcher entry.
candidate.productionFinding: The local regression source was memory-bearing and therefore restored all generated entry arguments. The broader admission also allowed callback-free legacy sources whose scratch usage does not establish the complete x0-x5 tier-one entry contract. A downstream tier-one memory target could therefore inherit invalid callback arguments. This is the leading explanation for the observed corrupted console fields and unmap-page-range loop, but the exact corrupting edge was not captured and is not claimed as proven.

verification.focused: The directed legacy-to-tier-one flag/state regression passed.
verification.deterministicAggregate: 1,556 tests in 179 suites passed with test parallelism disabled; the environment-driven pinned boot test skipped because its variables were absent, then the frozen fixture was executed explicitly.
verification.diffCheck: git diff --check passed before the focused implementation commit.

failedRun.loopEvidence: The final samples cycle through unmap_page_range, page-table helpers, spin locking, scheduler clock, and conditional rescheduling after /init starts.
failedRun.consoleCorruptionEvidence: The PCI ECAM domain text and a TSC mask line contain embedded NUL/corrupted bytes before the console stops at Run /init as init process.

disposition.reason: The candidate materially increased generated bypasses but failed production correctness before an authenticated receipt and remained below the dispatcher gate. It is fully reverted.

nextBoundary: Any mixed-compiler link must explicitly establish the complete target ABI, including x0-x5 callback arguments and lazy-flag state, at the actual generated edge. A narrowed source classification without edge-local proof is insufficient.
